baseline.equivalence_test: disabled selector exactly replays the unchanged synthetic-task baseline logits

core_invariants: keep the fixed label-free score-concentration witness unchanged
enumerate all unordered key pairs at inference; labels and evidence slots are not plugin inputs
keep the bounded zero-sum attention action and baseline metrics unchanged
do not modify or rerun the failed frozen independent-key experiment

plugins.insertion_point: candidate-pair scoring before bounded attention residual construction
plugins.hypothesis: connected XX after symmetric cross-register CZ gates identifies two-key relation consensus more reliably than independent key scores
plugins.resource_estimate: 4 data qubits, 4 trainable parameters, 2 CZ gates per pair, exact statevector Stage-0
failure_signatures: entangler-cut or key-shuffle drop is below 0.02

plugins.insertion_point: connected readout with cross-register gates disabled
plugins.hypothesis: the connected correlator is zero for the matched pure product state
plugins.input_schema: query,key,candidate_frames and frozen qccw local parameters
plugins.resource_estimate: 4 data qubits, shared 4 local parameters, 0 two-qubit gates

plugins.insertion_point: candidate-pair scoring before bounded attention residual construction
plugins.hypothesis: an equal-parameter symmetric low-rank bilinear interaction may explain the useful pair signal classically
failure_signatures: matches or exceeds qccw held-out action gain

plugins.hypothesis: removing both cross-register CZ gates destroys the connected witness while retaining local encoders
plugins.input_schema: query,key,candidate_frames and frozen qccw local parameters
plugins.resource_estimate: same local parameter budget as qccw, 0 two-qubit gates
failure_signatures: held-out accuracy drop from qccw is below 0.02

plugins.insertion_point: second key register before qccw encoding
plugins.hypothesis: a fixed within-query permutation of the second key breaks pair dependence while preserving one-key marginals
plugins.resource_estimate: same circuit and parameter budget as qccw
failure_signatures: held-out accuracy drop from qccw is below 0.02

plugins.insertion_point: historical independent-key field adapted to top-two support
plugins.hypothesis: the previous independent-key estimator provides a direct historical reference without changing its mechanism
plugins.output_schema: candidate score and top-two key support
plugins.resource_estimate: existing 3-qubit exact-statevector estimator, Stage-0 seed 7 only
failure_signatures: historical adapter changes existing estimator semantics

composition.merge_rule: one selector is evaluated at a time against the unchanged baseline and attention action

validation.baseline_equivalence: disabled selector predictions and logits exactly replay the unchanged task baseline
tests: baseline_equivalence: disabled selector exactly replays baseline logits
plugin_isolation: scorer inputs exclude labels and evidence slots
deterministic_replay: fixed inputs and parameters reproduce pair scores
interaction_ablation: product, bilinear, entangler-cut, key-shuffle, and independent-key controls
product-state connected XX is at most 1e-6
pair scores are invariant under exchanging key_a and key_b
plugin forward signatures accept no labels or evidence slots
all 15 unordered pairs are enumerated once
quantum and bilinear controls each expose exactly 4 trainable parameters
Stage-0 smoke run writes a frozen experiment manifest

reproducibility.environment: Python >=3.10 and torch >=2.0; exact statevector; CPU or one CUDA device

limitations: Stage 0 is a single synthetic seed and cannot support a promotion or task-utility claim
training uses gold candidate and evidence-pair targets, but inference enumerates all pairs and receives neither target
connected correlation is classically simulable and the bilinear control is mandatory
finite-shot, noise, hardware runtime, real data, and structured-NLP witnesses are out of scope
